root_idea.summary: The root centers on inclining, bending, or twisting something away from a straight course.
root_idea.development: From physical inclination and twisting, the lexicon develops uses for turning aside, distorting speech, complicating matters, delaying a debt, and naming things characterized by bending, separation, or stored-away status.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation form لَوَى.
Displayed as the distinct Quran-attested Form II verb لَوَّى.
Displayed as the verbal noun لَيّ.

senses.definition: To turn toward, pause for, or wait for someone.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic negative construction لَا تَلْوُونَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ, it denotes not stopping or turning back toward anyone while fleeing.

senses.definition: To twist or distort speech or wording, thereby misrepresenting it.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic usage concerns twisting the tongue in relation to scripture or distorting what is being stated; this is a figurative extension of turning something from its proper course.

senses.definition: To go around or round about something.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction لَوَى عَلَيْهِ is reported with this meaning in a Quran-commentary citation; the historical citation is not assigned a modern verse location here.

senses.definition: To turn or twist something aside, especially to turn the head away.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression لَوَّوْا رُؤُوسَهُمْ, it describes turning their heads aside in refusal or aversion.

senses.definition: Twisting or distortion of speech or the tongue.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لَيًّا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ, it denotes twisting the tongue so that speech is misrepresented.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist, wind, curl, curve, or bend a thing; to turn someone or something from its course and make it swerve.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive physical use and the related causative use of making something deviate are included.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To delay or procrastinate payment of a debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a debt or creditor in the conventional debt-delay construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an affair difficult and intricate for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction concerning the complication of a person's case or affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal information or an affair from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for withholding or concealing reported information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distort, wrest, or wring language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV usage specifically concerning the handling or distortion of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist or coil itself; to writhe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes self-coiling and writhing under physical pain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of two things, especially two serpents, twisting around one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist, wind, or bend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Neuter or intransitive Form VIII usage describing something as becoming twisted or bent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become difficult, intricate, or hard to attain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair or a need that becomes difficult to resolve or obtain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To behave perversely toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional interpersonal use describing perverse or contrary conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A banner or standard, especially a commander's or army's standard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term refers to a strip of cloth twisted or wound and tied to a spear shaft; it is distinguished from the larger رَايَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food set aside and stored for people who are absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word denotes provisions held back or turned aside from those presently present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Withered vegetation or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is associated with the plant's becoming twisted and inclined as it withers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To signal with an object, as one signals with the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ for indicating or gesturing with something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or carry something away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use understood as drawing or taking something toward oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who keeps apart and remains solitary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes one who habitually withdraws from companions into isolation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land situated far from water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained through the land's being turned away from the course of the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bend or termination of a sand tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: أَلْوَى القوم means that the people reached this bend or termination of the sand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speech that is obscure or difficult to follow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with clear, intelligible speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very contentious or quarrelsome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare descriptive lexical use preserved as reported.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Waiting for someone is covered by the Quranic لَوَى عَلَيْهِ construction.
The Quran-attested no-stopping or no-turning construction is represented.
Physical twisting and causing deviation are represented together.
The go-around construction is retained as a Quran-reported lexical use.
Making an affair difficult and intricate is represented.
Concealing information or an affair is represented.
Form IV distortion of language is represented.
Writhe under pain is covered by the broader twisting-self meaning.
Form VIII twisting, winding, and bending are represented.
An affair becoming difficult or intricate is represented.
A need becoming difficult of attainment is covered by the same difficulty construction.
Perverse conduct toward someone is represented.
The banner or standard is represented.
Poetic grammatical form of another word, with no independent lexical meaning here.
The rare descriptive meaning 'very contentious' is preserved.

cautions: The internal QAC lemma يَلْ is normalized to the Form I dictionary citation form لَوَى; the supplied Quran occurrences are imperfect forms.
Lane's historical Quran references for the waiting and go-around constructions are not converted into modern verse keys. Only independently supplied QAC locations are used for Quran examples.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Lane citation 'in liii. 20' attached to لَوَى عَلَيْهِ cannot be securely matched to a supplied modern QAC occurrence, so the reported go-around interpretation is retained without a modern verse location.
